name: What is the difference between a commercial and residential plumber?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a commercial and residential plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial plumbers specialize in plumbing systems for businesses, offices, and industrial facilities. These systems are typically larger, more complex, and subject to stricter regulations than residential plumbing. Commercial plumbers have expertise in high-demand fixtures, grease traps, industrial water heaters, and backflow prevention devices, which are common in commercial settings. They are also trained to minimize disruption to business operations during repairs or installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial plumbers specialize in complex, large-scale plumbing systems for businesses, while residential plumbers focus on home systems.
